The sha256 of PRECOMMIT_ONF1.md matches the .sha256 file and the reports, and the runner code uses exactly the registered candidates and parameters (tau, phi, gates, vc 0.09, fee x2 0.000166). The folder is not ready to hand to a design chat as it stands on the mount. `code/report_full.tmpl.md` carries the whole post-2014 report outside holdout/ and must move; the working copy already has it under holdout/, but the mirror has not been re-synced. RESULT_ONF1_KO.md itself and results/ are clean, and data_cut/ ends 2014-12-31 (US) and 2014-12-30 (KR).

The holdout was opened at 13:56Z, before the corrected T/F measurement (14:03Z, 14:05Z) and the steelman lane (14:00Z) finished, so "after the checks ended" is inexact. The pre-registration was not blind for the P group, whose MS1 and 1999-2026 numbers were computed before it. Neither changes the verdict.
